usedFor: Authress manages access and Slack is where the team talks, so “New Application” in Authress can post through “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Application” in Authress, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: The team hears about each new application in a channel, thread or direct message you choose.

watchOut: An automation's post to a Slack channel waits for your approval today, and “New Application” is polling.
